description: An animated smiling face emoji suitable for chat applications or user feedback. The animation shows a happy face with a winking expression and a tongue sticking out.

Face.description: The main circular shape of the face.

Eyes.description: The fill colors for both eyes.

Mouth.description: Components of the mouth, including the interior and tongue.

DarkFeatures.description: Elements that share the same dark color, creating a cohesive look for the eyes and mouth interior.

HighPriority.description: The most prominent element, defining the overall color of the emoji.

MediumPriority.description: An important detail color that adds personality.

LowPriority.description: Accent colors for facial features that can be themed together.

PrimaryElement.description: The primary visual component that forms the base of the emoji.

SecondaryElements.description: Secondary facial features that define the expression.

AccentElement.description: Subtle background color within the mouth.

optionalAiContext.purpose: This animation is designed to convey happiness, playfulness, or positive reinforcement. It's suitable for social interactions, rewards, or successful state feedback in applications.

optionalAiStylePrompts.cyberpunk: Generate a theme with neon purples, electric blues, and glowing pinks, giving the emoji a futuristic, digital feel.
optionalAiStylePrompts.vintage: Create a retro theme using faded yellows, muted reds, and off-whites, reminiscent of classic cartoons.
optionalAiStylePrompts.corporate: Apply a professional theme using a brand's primary and secondary colors, making the face fill the primary color and details the accent colors.

FaceMainFill.name: FaceMainFill
FaceMainFill.description: The main fill color for the circular face, acting as the skin tone of the emoji.

FaceMouthBackgroundFill.name: FaceMouthBackgroundFill
FaceMouthBackgroundFill.description: The dark background color of the open mouth, visible behind the tongue.

FaceTongueFill.name: FaceTongueFill
FaceTongueFill.description: The fill color for the tongue inside the smiling mouth.

FaceEyeLeftFill.name: FaceEyeLeftFill
FaceEyeLeftFill.description: The fill color for the face's left eye.

FaceEyeRightFill.name: FaceEyeRightFill
FaceEyeRightFill.description: The fill color for the face's right eye.
